name: TBUploadApp
description: Upload a mobile app (.apk, .aab, .ipa, .zip) to TestingBot Storage and export its tb:// app URL for Appium tests
author: TestingBot
helpMarkDown: Uploads a native app build to TestingBot Storage and exports the returned tb:// URL as a pipeline variable (default TB_APP_URL) for use as the Appium 'app' capability.

inputs.name: connectedServiceName
inputs.label: TestingBot Credentials
inputs.helpMarkDown: The TestingBot service connection holding your key and secret.

inputs.name: appFile
inputs.label: App file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the app build to upload: .apk / .aab (Android), .ipa (iOS device) or .zip (iOS simulator).

inputs.name: outputVariable
inputs.label: Output variable
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the pipeline variable to set to the returned tb:// app URL. Use it as the Appium 'app' capability in a later step.

inputs.name: overwrite
inputs.label: Overwrite an existing app
inputs.helpMarkDown: Overwrite a previously uploaded app so its tb:// URL stays the same across builds (the 'always upload the latest build' CI pattern).

inputs.name: appId
inputs.label: Existing app (tb:// URL or appkey)
inputs.helpMarkDown: The tb:// URL (or bare appkey) of the app to overwrite.
